title: Nuevo Laredo firefighters free worker's hand trapped in press at Gorditas Doña Tota
excerpt: Firefighters in Nuevo Laredo freed a worker whose right hand was trapped in a mechanical food-preparation press at Gorditas Doña Tota on Avenida Reforma. She was taken to a private hospital, and Protección Civil is now reviewing the shop's safety measures.
content:
Emergency crews in Nuevo Laredo rescued a worker whose right hand was trapped in a mechanical food-preparation press at the Gorditas Doña Tota restaurant, according to Central de Noticias Tamaulipas.

The worker, identified only as Carolina "N," was at the restaurant in a shopping plaza on Avenida Reforma, near Calle Toluca, when her hand became caught in the press during the late afternoon or evening on Monday, the outlet reported.

Her coworkers stopped the equipment and called for help. Firefighters with Nuevo Laredo's Civil Protection and Fire Department freed her hand and gave her first aid at the scene for a skin injury to her right hand, according to the report.

At the worker's request, she was taken to a private hospital, with the transfer arranged by the store's managers. The incident was first reported on Wednesday, Nov. 11.

The Civil Protection and Fire Department has opened a review of the business to verify that its workplace safety and hygiene protocols are in order. The department's director, Humberto Fernández Diez de Pinos, said staff are reviewing the facilities to confirm the shop has its required safety measures and to determine whether there was a mechanical failure or mishandling of the equipment.

Sources: Central de Noticias Tamaulipas, Nov. 11, 2026; centralnoticiastamaulipas.com.
